messages:
Marco: quick heads-up 12 leads sat in 'Awaiting Enrichment' this morning and never got an owner because our enrichment webhook timed out. we need a fast mitigation before Monday. :grimacing:
Anya: is that the HubSpot enrichment lambda or the SFDC path?
Marco: enrichment lambda. upstream service returned spikes of 5xx which caused the webhook to hang until our 60s timeout. HS stage blocked assignment.
Sam: tactical idea: fallback to a temporary SDR pool after a short grace period, so leads don't sit unassigned.
Devon: agree. propose 30s grace then assign to "inbound-temp-pool" and set a contact note "auto-fallback:enrich-timeout-30s"
Anya: also emit a metric so we can alert on it. and tag the contact with a counter to track repeat fallbacks.
Lina: question: implement fallback in the webhook vs in a HubSpot workflow? webhook is faster to push, workflow is more visible to ops.
Marco: let's do webhook-first for speed, but add a HubSpot contact property that a workflow can surface to the UI.
Anya: suggested webhook pseudo: 
```
start timer on receive; try_enrich(retries=1, backoff=500ms);
if enrich_not_done_after(30s):
  set_property('enrich_fallback','webhook-30s');
  assign_owner('inbound-temp-pool');
  increment_metric('lead.enrich.fallback');
```
Sam: add a dedupe guard so SF sync won't stomp an existing SF owner. last time we had duplicate owner churn.
Devon: sync rule: only push owner to SF if sfdc_owner is null OR force_owner flag is true. add fallback_owner_applied flag so sync can ignore owner overwrite.
HS Bot: webhook event logged: contact.2048 enrichment_status=timeout (simulated)
Lina: I'll implement retry (1x), 30s fallback timer, and emit the metric in staging now. PR will be up and I'll post endpoint for testing.
Sam: I can validate SDR queue behavior and update the SDR slack note to explain what 'auto-fallback' means.
Devon: I'll run a 200-lead canary against staging tomorrow at 10:00 PT and capture assignment latency + fallback rate.
Anya: I'll add a Datadog monitor: alert if fallback rate > 2% for 15m and create a dashboard tile for median assignment latency.
Marco: timeline: Lina deploy to staging today, canary tomorrow, aim for prod Monday morning if green. post-deploy playbook: if fallback spikes, increase retries to 2, consider extending fallback window to 60s for batch windows, and open incident if fallback > 5% sustained.
Sam: can we have a one-line blurb for SDRs? they should know not to panic.
Marco: one-liner: "Leads that fail enrichment will auto-assign to a temporary inbound pool after 30s and receive a contact note 'auto-fallback:enrich-timeout-30s'. SF owner updates are blocked unless explicitly forced."
Lina: patch merged to staging: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/1290. staging endpoint: https://staging.hub-webhook.redwood/enrich-fallback. ping me when you want to run canary.
Devon: canary scheduled for 10:00 PT, I'll post results in this thread.
Sam: I'll standby for queue checks and update SDR doc.
Anya: created monitor and dashboard tile (Datadog link: https://app.datadog/redwood/dash/8843).
Marco: great work team. we'll review metrics after canary and ship to prod Monday if clean. adding this to Monday stand agenda. :rocket:
